title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code
authors: M. Chen, J. Tworek, H. Jun, et al. (58 authors)
before: Code generation was evaluated by text similarity to a reference solution.
problem: Similarity to a reference says nothing about whether the code runs correctly.
breakthrough: Fine-tune GPT on public code and evaluate by executing unit tests, via the HumanEval benchmark.
why: Functional correctness as the metric is why coding became the field's clearest measure of progress.
next: Copilot productised it; HumanEval led to SWE-bench and the agentic coding benchmarks.
inherits: Execution-based evaluation, now standard for code models.
